mission: Execute cross-mechanism simulation validation for the newly inducted physical analogs to satisfy Level C5 (Mechanism Independent) requirements.

step_1_mass_inertia.test: Apply P_delta perturbation to stabilized triadic locks of varying residue density.
step_1_mass_inertia.expected: m scales linearly with rho * Omega.

step_2_energy_conservation.test: Monitor global H_app scalar during regime transitions (e.g., transformation to confinement).
step_2_energy_conservation.expected: Delta H_app < epsilon_precision across closed basins.

step_3_braid_quantization.test: Initialize orientation cycles and filter for admissible closure signatures.
step_3_braid_quantization.expected: Only discrete integer/half-integer analogs satisfy FixedPoint(Psi).

step_4_dimensionality_rank.test: Perform rank analysis on the independent closure-constraint set of stabilized knots.
step_4_dimensionality_rank.expected: rank=3 for stable triadic volumes projecting 3D accessibility.

step_5_shared_residue_entanglement.test: Execute arbitration at locus alpha and monitor admissibility updates at locus beta with shared manifold.
step_5_shared_residue_entanglement.expected: Instantaneous update in beta's admissibility set under ordering prec.

step_6_boundary_invariants.test: Parameter sweep across multiple seeds to identify upper propagation bounds and signal loss constants.
step_6_boundary_invariants.expected: Invariance of limits across independent mechanism classes.
